pages.quiz:
INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

2. When learning Audial- Visual Creation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Audial- Visual Creation.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Audial- Visual Creation.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Audial- Visual Creation.

3. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Work alone with eyes closed
   B. Remove all guards
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Keyboard
   C. Speaker
   D. CPU

5. When learning Emerging Trends in ICT, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Emerging Trends in ICT.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Emerging Trends in ICT.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Emerging Trends in ICT.

6. When learning Robotics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Robotics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Robotics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Robotics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

7. When learning Digital Citizenship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Digital Citizenship.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Digital Citizenship.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Digital Citizenship.

8. When learning Artificial Intelligence, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Artificial Intelligence.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Artificial Intelligence.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Artificial Intelligence.

9. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Internal Cooking Timer
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Information and Communication Technology

10. When learning Graphic Design, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Graphic Design.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Graphic Design.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Graphic Design.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Audial- Visual Creation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Digital Citizenship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Emerging Trends in ICT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Never touch live wires with wet hands

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Audial- Visual Creation.

3. D — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

4. D — CPU

5. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Emerging Trends in ICT.

6. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Robotics.

7. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Digital Citizenship.

8. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Artificial Intelligence.

9. D — Information and Communication Technology

10. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Graphic Design.

11. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Graphic Design; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

12. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Audial- Visual Creation; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Digital Citizenship; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Emerging Trends in ICT; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
